findings.detail: WI-08 adds NEW endpoints GET /geo/geocode and GET /geo/reverse but has no happy-path test for either (geocode Found=true match; reverse 200 resolved address). Every endpoint needs a happy-path test. Add HandleAsync_GeocodeMatch_Returns200Found and HandleAsync_ReverseValidCoords_Returns200Address.
WI-10 modifies two endpoints but omits rules/api-design.md from rule_citations. The developer reads only cited rules. Add rules/api-design.md#endpoint-pattern and #send-pattern.
WI-11 modifies AcceptOrderEndpoint.cs but omits rules/api-design.md from rule_citations. Add rules/api-design.md#endpoint-pattern.

WI-09 defines the error path 'route Unavailable -> 502 Geo.RouteUnavailable' but no test case exercises the proxy's 502 (only WI-10's downstream Pricing fallback is tested). Explicit error paths need a test. Add HandleAsync_RouteUpstreamUnavailable_Returns502.
WI-12 AC requires alerts at 80% AND 100% of GeoMonthlyCreditBudget but test_cases only prove the 80% crossing. Add a 100%-threshold fires-once test and assert 80% does not re-fire (dedup).

The DataProtection persisted key-ring is captured in code (WI-03) but no WI provisions an actual persistent volume: WI-03 falls back to a 'sensible local default' dir and WI-18 adds only a runbook note. A container redeploy without a mounted volume wipes the ring -> stored fleet Mapy keys become permanently undecryptable. Add a deployment-config deliverable (mounted keys volume in infra compose) or a fail-fast startup guard, not a runbook note alone.

WI-11 introduces an in-memory singleton viewer counter (OrderSubscriptionTracker). API-side, mirrors the DriverPositionStore precedent so acceptable; impl agent must register it singleton and reset per-test.
WI-12 names the policy 'DispatcherOnly/FleetAdmin'; both DispatcherOnly and FleetAdminOnly policies exist. Impl agent must select one concrete nameof(...) policy.

notes: Schema file .claude/schemas/design-review.v1.json does not exist (documented scaffold gap). Reviewer had no write tool in-session; JSON persisted by the conductor. Passing (do-not-relitigate): AC->WI coverage all 8 mapped; DAG acyclic; shared-file serialization chains hold; vertical-slice placement correct; GeoResult Success|Unavailable seam sound; AC#5 orientacni-odhad is a body field not header; AC#7 server-key structurally excluded; EF composite PKs/DateOnly/jsonb/non-tenant geo_cache/ON CONFLICT upsert/additive migration all sound; frontend shared MapyMap + code-splitting + i18n parity + OSM CI guard sound.
